response.justification: Despite extensive senior-level experience, the candidate lacks junior-level alignment: Java is listed among skills but not used in recent roles, German is only basic (required fluent), and the resume reflects a senior/consultant profile inconsistent with an entry-level role requiring team integration and client collaboration in insurance domain.
strengths: Extensive full-stack experience across multiple languages and platforms
Strong open-source contributions and technical teaching background
Proven track record in agile practices, CI/CD, and test-driven development
concerns: German language proficiency is only basic, not meeting fluency requirement
No recent Java project experience despite Java being a core requirement
Overqualified with 10+ years of senior roles, suggesting misalignment with entry-level expectations
